Gestionamos reclamaciones judiciales de principio a fin, desde el cliente y su contrato hasta el último papel que llega del juzgado. El backend es una API REST en Symfony 7.4 con PHP 8.5, y aquí la IA no es de adorno: la usamos en un montón de procesos del día a día, con microservicios en Python que tiran de Claude y Gemini. Por ejemplo: Notificaciones judiciales: las clasificamos y sacamos de ellas lo que nos interesa. Documentos jurídicos y de clientes: los analizamos. Escritos y demandas: los generamos. Expedientes: tenemos asistentes para trabajar con ellos. Informes: salen solos. Y para programar, igual: aquí ya no escribimos código a mano, lo escriben los LLMs. Nuestro trabajo es entender bien el problema, fijar los requisitos y el diseño, guiar a la IA durante todo el proceso y asegurarnos de que lo que sale es correcto, está probado y no rompe nada. Tú pones el criterio y la IA pone las manos.

¿Qué vas a hacer? Somos un equipo pequeño y aquí todos hacemos de todo, analizar lo que nos piden, desarrollar nuevas funcionalidades, resolver incidencias, mejorar lo que ya funciona, y echar una mano con sistemas y documentación. Construir y mantener endpoints, servicios y procesos asíncronos. Meter LLMs en flujos reales de negocio, no en demos. Pelearte con incidencias de producción y llegar al fondo del asunto. Hablar con el equipo legal y de procura para entender qué necesitan y convertirlo en algo que funcione y les agilice el día a día. Meterte en el código que ya existe, entenderlo y decidir dónde hay que meter mano. Escribir tests, documentar y revisar con lupa lo que te propone la IA antes de darlo por bueno.

Lo que necesitamos que domines: Buscamos un perfil senior, con 4 años o más de experiencia como backend developer. PHP y Symfony: PHP 8, tipado estricto y orientación a objetos de verdad. Symfony 6 o superior: inyección de dependencias, Security, Messenger, Validator. Doctrine ORM y Migrations. APIs e integraciones: APIs REST bien hechas: DTOs, validación, errores coherentes y OpenAPI. Hablar con servicios externos: clientes HTTP, timeouts, reintentos y webhooks. Trabajar con ficheros (PDF, DOCX) y almacenamiento en la nube. Datos y asincronía: SQL sin miedo: MySQL/MariaDB, índices, bloqueos y migraciones que no rompan nada en producción. Colas y workers (Messenger, Redis), reintentos e idempotencia. Calidad y seguridad: Tests con PHPUnit, unitarios y funcionales. PHPStan y PHP-CS-Fixer como parte natural del flujo. Código limpio y SOLID. JWT, API keys, Voters y lo básico de OWASP. Herramientas: Git con Gitflow y merge requests. Docker y Docker Compose. Moverte por Linux con soltura: SSH, cron, supervisor y logs.

Puntos extra: Python, porque media IA vive ahí. Google Cloud (GCS, Vertex AI). GitLab CI. Observabilidad: logs, alertas y diagnóstico en producción. Legaltech o mundillo judicial (LexNET y compañía).

IA, el corazón del puesto: Has integrado LLMs en aplicaciones: prompts, salida estructurada, validar respuestas y vigilar el coste. Programas con Claude Code, Codex o similares, y no a ratos: es tu forma de trabajar. Sabes guiarlos, darles el contexto que necesitan y llevarlos por donde tú quieres para sacar código rápido y fiable. Gracias a eso eres un programador 10x: ágil, resolutivo y capaz de pasar de la idea a producción en poco tiempo. Aquí vamos muy, muy rápido.

Encajas si… Te gusta resolver problemas de negocio: aquí no te van a llegar tareas masticadas, te van a llegar problemas, y la solución la buscas tú. Te gusta tirar del hilo hasta entender qué pasa de verdad. Te interesa el negocio y no solo el código. Vas a tener que entender cómo funciona el sector legal en España: cómo van los juzgados, qué pasos tiene cada proceso, quién hace qué… No hace falta que lo sepas ya, pero sí que tengas ganas de aprenderlo. Escribes claro: análisis y documentación que se entiendan a la primera

Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives.

Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment.

The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

 
 

The Role

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of scalable backend services and data infrastructure that power our clinical trial data platform. You will own major parts of our backend architecture, from APIs and data models to integration with cloud services and machine learning components, while being comfortable contributing across the stack when needed. You will collaborate closely with product, data, and frontend teams to ship high-quality features iteratively and help shape the future of our platform.

To succeed in this role, you should have a passion for iterative product development and possess a strategic, analytical mindset. You should be comfortable navigating the uncertainties of a startup environment, adaptable to shifting priorities, and driven to transform the pharmaceutical industry. Embrace the challenge of building the future of clinical trial technology and help realize Rivia's vision of becoming the definitive unified data infrastructure for clinical trials.

 

Our stack

Some technologies we use today: Typescript, React, Java, Python, Spring, Postgres, GPT-4, AWS, Kubernetes.

There's no need to be a prior expert in our stack; it's more important that you learn new technologies quickly.

 

What excites you

  • Building high quality software that delights end users

  • Owning the architecture, implementation, and operation of core backend services and APIs.

  • Designing robust data models and storage patterns that make complex clinical trial data manageable and performant.

  • Solving hard problems around scalability, reliability, and performance in a data-heavy environment.

  • Thriving in a fast-paced startup environment where you have autonomy over your work and make strategic decisions that impact users and the team

  • Working with cloud infrastructure and modern tooling to build secure, observable, and maintainable services

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs (primarily in Java/Spring) that power our clinical trial platform.

  • Model, store, and query complex data efficiently in Postgres and related data systems.

  • Implement and maintain integrations and pipelines that ingest and process data from multiple sources.

  • Collaborate with frontend engineers to define API contracts and, when needed, contribute full‑stack changes to ship complete features.

  • Ensure high availability, observability, and security of backend services through monitoring, testing, and sound operational practices.

  • Participate in technical planning, code reviews, and knowledge sharing to continuously improve the team’s effectiveness.

 

What Excites us

  • Strong experience building and operating backend services in production, ideally with Java, Spring, and relational databases like Postgres.

  • A solid understanding of system design, data modeling, and performance optimization for data-intensive applications.

  • Experience working with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and containerized environments (e.g., Docker/Kubernetes).

  • Ability and willingness to work across the stack when required to deliver high-quality product experiences.

Hiring Process

Our hiring process takes 2-4 weeks over four distinct stages:

  1. Meet and greet: 30-minute call with the HR team to get to know each other. This is an informal chat.

  2. Technical Screening: 60-minute interview to delve into high-level technical concepts and your problem-solving approaches.

  4. Meet the team: 3-4 hours. Join us at our Zürich office for a visit that includes a team lunch and an in-depth technical interview to explore our mutual fit.

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

  • In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions.

  • Embrace change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead

The role

Aniah develops OneCheck, a transistor-level electrical rule checker for analog, mixed-signal and digital designs. OneCheck analyzes the full-chip netlist without stimuli or simulation and detects ESD, power-domain, floating-node, level-shifting, leakage and reliability errors. It is deployed at most Tier-1 semiconductor companies.

As an Application Engineer, you drive OneCheck adoption at customers and you develop the checks that extend its coverage. Part of the AE team, you work day to day with customers and R&D: the role requires both technical depth and effective communication skills.


Responsibilities

  • Check development: code electrical rules from customers or the literature as checks on OneCheck’s analysis engine — specification, implementation, validation on test circuits, integration. You write the code and owns the quality, with AI as part of the workflow.
  • Quality of results: ensure every real error is reported with minimal noise, and that setup and results are natural to a designer.
  • Pre- and post-sales support: lead demonstrations, benchmarks and evaluations on customer designs; drive deployment into production; resolve technical issues, onsite when required.
  • Product feedback: deliver structured feedback from the field to R&D and influence the roadmap.
  • AI workflows: author agent workflows on OneCheck’s MCP interface, starting with automated review of ERC results, and define what the engine exposes next. Foster AI usage in analog design with our customers.


Requirements

  • MSc in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
  • Typically 3–5 years of analog or mixed-signal IC design on production circuits; ability outweighs seniority.
  • Solid command of ESD, power domains, level shifters, interfaces and reliability.
  • Hands-on Virtuoso-type flow and SPICE simulation experience.
  • Strong appetite for code, in both algorithmic understanding and execution (Python, SKILL, JavaScript or equivalent). Checks are written in JavaScript, which can be learned on the job.
  • Linux/Unix proficiency.
  • Fluent English, working French; able to engage senior designers, CAD teams and R&D.


Preferred

  • Experience with Calibre PERC, DRC/LVS or parasitic extraction.
  • Exposure to customer support or EDA environments.


About Aniah

Our startup, founded in 2019, has 15 employees in Grenoble and Taiwan who specialize in algorithm research, analog design, and EDA. A new round of funding was secured in the summer of 2026 to support international expansion and extend OneCheck—a solution initially designed for ERC verification—to include combined electrical and physical verification.

Aniah has already won numerous awards, attesting to its innovation and the relevance of its solution to market needs: Acsiel Startup of the Year 2023, i-Venture Tech&Fest 2025, IC Taiwan Grand Challenge 2026, AI Best Award Taiwan 2026, and FrenchTech 2025 & 2026.


Practical

  • Grenoble, next to the train station
  • Up to 2 days/week remote
  • Occasional travel abroad for client assignments (France, the United States, Taiwan)
  • Salary based on experience


Apply

Send your CV to recrutement@aniah.fr with a few lines on an analog or mixed-signal design problem you are proud of having solved. Every application receives an answer.

leboncoin, est le 1er site généraliste de vente entre particuliers en France, leader sur les marchés de l’immobilier et l’automobile, acteur clé sur les biens de consommation de seconde main et sur l’emploi.

Chaque mois leboncoin est plébiscité par 30 millions de Français qui apprécient la richesse de son offre et la facilité des échanges qu’il permet au quotidien.

leboncoin a été élu Marque préférée des Français dans les catégories “site de seconde main”, “immobilier” et “automobile” en 2026.

Exigences du poste

Au sein de la régie publicitaire, vous êtes l’interlocuteur·rice privilégié·e des équipes commerciales, Programmatique / Media Trading, Marketing, Produit & Tech, Data, Legal & Privacy et des partenaires technologiques. Vous recueillez les besoins métiers et identifiez les opportunités de création de valeur. Vous définissez les solutions adaptées et pilotez les projets de bout en bout, du cadrage à la mise en production, en collaboration avec les équipes Produit & Tech, qui réalisent les développements. Vous assurez ensuite le suivi des performances et veillez à ce que les solutions déployées répondent aux enjeux business, de monétisation et d’expérience utilisateur.

  • Piloter l'intégration et l'évolution de solutions AdTech (SSP, DSP, header bidding, ad serving, mesure, consentement, Retail Media), en coordonnant partenaires et équipes internes, dépendances, risques et jalons.
  • Recueillir et challenger les besoins business et opérationnels de la régie, les traduire en cadrages fonctionnels et exigences techniques, puis les prioriser avec les parties prenantes.
  • Assurer l'interface entre la régie, P&T (Produit, Web, Android, iOS, Backend), Data, Marketing, Legal & Privacy et les prestataires, en garantissant une communication claire et des arbitrages partagés.
  • Piloter simultanément plusieurs projets, du cadrage aux tests, à la mise en production et au bilan, en suivant planning, priorités, qualité, risques et indicateurs de succès.
  • Contribuer aux recettes et diagnostics techniques (Google Ad Manager, bid requests, tags, SDK, outils de debugging), analyser les performances et coordonner les corrections et optimisations avec P&T et les partenaires.
  • Être force de proposition sur l'optimisation de la monétisation et du stack publicitaire : rendement programmatique, latence, visibilité, consentement, nouveaux formats et solutions du marché ; partager les bonnes pratiques avec les équipes concernées.

Responsabilités liées au poste

  • Expérience confirmée en gestion de projets AdTech, idéalement chez un éditeur, une régie publicitaire ou un acteur de la publicité programmatique.
  • Très bonne connaissance de la publicité digitale et de ses principaux outils et mécanismes : ad serving, Google Ad Manager, SSP, DSP, OpenRTB, header bidding, SDK, CMP et mesure publicitaire.
  • Bonne compréhension des environnements Web et App (iOS, Android, SDK, tags, cycles de release) et capacité à dialoguer avec des équipes de développement, sans nécessairement coder au quotidien.
  • Maîtrise de Google Ad Manager et compréhension des leviers d’optimisation des revenus publicitaires : taux de remplissage, CPM, floors, visibilité et latence.
  • Bases solides en JavaScript, HTML, tracking et analyse des flux publicitaires. La pratique d’outils de diagnostic et de recette technique est un plus.
  • Sens business, esprit d’analyse, autonomie, rigueur, capacité de synthèse et très bonnes qualités de communication et de coordination.
  • Anglais professionnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, pour échanger avec des partenaires internationaux.

Avantages du poste

  • Des conditions de travail agréables
  • Une rémunération attractive
  • Une carte tickets restaurants et une couverture mutuelle et prévoyance efficace et compétitive

Chez leboncoin, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des points de vue est une richesse essentielle. Cet engagement se reflète pleinement dans notre processus de recrutement : nous évaluons chaque candidature uniquement au regard des compétences, de l’expérience et de la motivation, sans aucune forme de discrimination.

Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement spécifique dans le cadre du processus de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous en faire part : nous serons ravis de vous accompagner.

About Tessl

AI is transforming how software is built, and at Tessl, we're building the infrastructure for what comes next.

We're developing a platform that enables engineering teams to build and run AI-powered software factories, where coding agents take on real development work, from picking up engineering tickets to implementing changes and creating pull requests.

By combining structured context, reusable agent skills, automated workflows and evaluations, we're making AI-powered development more reliable, repeatable and scalable, while keeping humans in control. We're tackling some of the biggest challenges in autonomous software development, from code quality and security to helping organisations confidently adopt AI agents at scale.

Founded by Guy Podjarny, previously founder of Snyk, Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup backed by over $100 million in funding from investors including Index Ventures, Accel, GV and Boldstart.

Joining Tessl means helping define an entirely new category of technology, solving ambitious technical challenges and shaping the future of software development.

OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE

Join our engineering team to build real-time AI Native workflows, tooling, and interfaces that will reshape how developers create and maintain software.

This is a product engineering role with a platform twist. Most of your time, you'll do what every Tessl engineer does: design, prototype and ship product features end to end, collaborating closely with product, design and the wider engineering team in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment. What makes you different is that when the work goes below the application layer, you light up rather than back away: complex networking scenarios such as site-to-site VPN and private connectivity, multi-cloud and multi-region deployments, observability, and the machinery that makes Tessl straightforward to deploy, operate and support wherever it needs to run.

We expect you to be relentlessly AI native about it: instead of triaging alerts at 2 am, you'll build or deploy the agent that does it. Instead of reacting to scaling bottlenecks, you'll create systems that spot them before they happen. Deep expertise is the foundation, because you can't automate what you don't know, but your ambition should be to make agents do the bulk of the operational work, with you supervising and steering.

We're open on level for this role, from mid-level to senior: trajectory and appetite matter more to us than years.

What success looks like: Within your first year, you're shipping product features end to end like any Tessl engineer. When infrastructure work arises, from deployment architecture to networking to observability, you're the one who takes it on and lands it well, with support where you need it. Our deployment and operational practices are stronger because of you, agentic tooling handles a growing share of the toil, and the infrastructure work you touch is compliant by default, keeping our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 journey unblocked.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

No two days will be the same at Tessl! You'll have a high level of autonomy and be empowered to make decisions based on what you believe will help you deliver the most success. Here's an insight into just a few of the things you would be doing:

Product engineering (most of your time)

  • Design and implement new functionality end to end, from initial design and prototypes to fully scoped production implementations, reviewed with the product team

  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities to prove or disprove an idea, then develop a plan for a scalable implementation

  • Pair with designers and other engineers to make the experience intuitive and slick, and integrate third-party services so we can focus our cycles on Tessl's core capabilities

  • Gather requirements from customers and stakeholders, turn ambiguity into agreed plans, and deliver them

Platform & infrastructure

  • Lean into infrastructure work as it arises: our AWS estate (EKS/Kubernetes), infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and our observability stack (Dash0/OpenTelemetry, Sentry, PostHog)

  • Contribute to the architecture & build of our more complex networking and deployment scenarios, such as private connectivity and multi-region setups

  • Improve developer experience and platform ergonomics so every engineer at Tessl ships faster

  • Partner with our Infosec team so that everything you build is compliant by default, contributing infrastructure controls and evidence towards ISO 27001 and SOC 2

AI-native automation

  • Build or deploy agentic tooling that picks up firing alerts and works through diagnostic steps autonomously, giving a human supervisor a detailed assessment with recommended actions

  • Build agents that keep our estate healthy without human toil: dependency upgrades that test and merge themselves, alerts that arrive pre-diagnosed, runbooks that execute instead of sitting in a wiki

  • Continuously spot repetitive manual work, across product, platform and on-call workflows, and convert it into agent-driven automation

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for someone who is as excited as we are to be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future of AI and software development. We're committed to building a diverse team and strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Must-haves

  • Proven experience as a Software Engineer (TypeScript/Node preferred): you care about code modularity, structure and aesthetics, and you're equally comfortable contributing to a mature codebase with strict CI criteria or hacking up a quick prototype to prove an assumption

  • A genuine pull towards platform and infrastructure work, backed by hands-on experience: you've deployed and operated real systems (Kubernetes, cloud environments, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD), and when the chance came to go deeper, you took it, whether that was owning platform or DevOps work in a previous role or picking up the infrastructure tasks nobody else wanted

  • Solid systems and networking fundamentals: DNS, TLS, VPCs, firewalls; you can reason and debug below the application layer with confidence

  • Demonstrated use of AI coding tools and agents to accelerate your own work, and excitement about experimenting with new AI approaches to transform how engineering is done

  • Comfortable with fast-paced, high-autonomy environments: you turn loose requirements into plans and shipped work without waiting to be told

Nice-to-haves

  • You self-host things for fun: a homelab, your own services, a Kubernetes cluster nobody asked you to run

  • Production AWS/EKS experience, or hands-on work with private connectivity, VPNs, or multi-region architectures

  • Experience producing infrastructure evidence for certifications such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2

  • You've thrived in an early-stage startup before

  • Have a cool project to show us (GitHub links welcome!)

The kind of person you are

  • You're a product engineer first: you measure infrastructure by what it lets the team ship, and you see platform work as making every engineer faster, never a domain to guard

  • You're calm under pressure, including when production is misbehaving and the answer is three layers down the stack

  • You think big about how AI changes the job: the best engineers automate themselves out of the repetitive loop and operate at the scale of a team

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change, and you grab a shovel when something needs doing outside your lane

  • You communicate clearly and bring people along: product, security, engineers and customers all need to trust your judgement

Application Process

Here's an outline of what you can expect during our interview process:

  1. Introductory Call with one of our engineering leaders. A relaxed chat to learn about your background, interests, and career goals. We'll also share more about the role, Tessl's vision, and answer any questions you have.

  2. Take-Home Exercise. You'll receive a practical challenge based on real scenarios you might tackle at Tessl: an opportunity to showcase your approach to problem-solving on your own schedule.

  3. On-site Technical Session. You'll pair with two of our lead engineers to build on your take-home exercise. This session simulates working together on real problems and allows us to explore your technical expertise more deeply.

  4. Culture Conversation with our People Lead. A two-way dialogue about our values, team dynamic, and your motivations. Feel free to ask about life at Tessl, growth opportunities, or anything else you're curious about.

  5. Leadership Discussion with Maurilio (Head of Engineering), and potentially also with Guy (CEO) or Dru (Head of Product). Our final stage focuses on strategic alignment and long-term vision. You'll learn more about Tessl's roadmap and how you could contribute to our mission.

Throughout the process, if you have any specific requirements or need adjustments, please let us know: we're happy to accommodate.

Life at Tessl

We want Tessl to be a place where you can do meaningful work, keep learning and enjoy being part of the team. Alongside competitive compensation, we offer benefits designed to support you both inside and outside work.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and equity: Market-benchmarked salaries and EMI share options.

  • Time off: 25 days of annual leave, plus UK public holidays, and two paid volunteering days each year.

  • Private healthcare: Vitality medical insurance, including dental, optical and mental health support, with cover included for partners and dependants.

  • Pension: A 5% employer pension matched contribution through Smart Pension.

  • Life assurance: Company-paid life insurance with MetLife providing cover of four times your annual salary.

  • Family Leave: We offer enhanced Maternity, Parental and Adoption Leave from day one to support you and your growing family.

  • Learning and development: We support opportunities to continue developing your skills with a £1,000 per year to spend.

  • Commuting benefits: Financial support for eligible team members commuting from outside Greater London, plus a Cycle to Work scheme.

  • Summer & winter offsites: Twice a year, we bring the whole Tessl team together for a week-long offsite. It's a chance to step away from our usual routines, collaborate on big ideas, build stronger relationships and enjoy shared experiences together. And of course, we have a lot of fun along the way!

Our London HQ

Our office is in the heart of King's Cross, surrounded by London's growing AI and technology community.

We work together in person on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, giving us time to collaborate, exchange ideas and build relationships. You'll also enjoy catered lunches (Tuesday & Thursday), plenty of office snacks, regular team lunches and socials, plus a pet-friendly workplace.

How we work

Our operating principles shape how we collaborate and make decisions. We move quickly and learn by doing, build on ideas before challenging them, get stuck in wherever we can help, and give people real ownership. We encourage thoughtful debate, curiosity and a willingness to try things that haven't been done before. Read our five operating principles.

We're AI native

AI isn't just what we're building - it's central to how we work every day, across every function. We actively use AI to improve how we work, solve problems and challenge traditional ways of doing things.

You don't need to be an AI expert to thrive at Tessl, but you do need curiosity, an appetite for experimentation and a willingness to embrace new ways of working. We expect everyone to use AI regularly, invest time in learning how to get the most from it and keep experimenting when something doesn't work the first time, rather than defaulting to manual approaches.

We're also big believers in sharing what we learn. We encourage transparency about how we're using AI, what's working, what isn't and how we can help each other improve. Being AI native doesn't mean removing human judgement, it means using AI thoughtfully, while taking ownership of the quality and outcomes of our work.

Everyone is welcome at Tessl

We're committed to building an inclusive environment where people from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives can thrive.

We particularly welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in technology. If you're excited about the opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we'd still encourage you to apply.

If you need any adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to work with you to make the process accessible and comfortable.

Come build with us

We're moving fast, experimenting boldly and figuring things out as we go. There's plenty to build, lots to learn and real opportunities to make your mark.

If you're excited by big ideas, enjoy getting stuck in and want to be part of something from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you!

Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

As a Security Engineer, you’ll own application security for a fast-growing AI companionship platform. This is a hands-on AppSec role: you’ll review code, find real vulnerabilities and drive fixes across the stack. You’ll be the main security person in the company, reporting directly to our CTO and Co-Founder. You’ll set direction yourself and explain risk clearly to non-security colleagues. Our product includes AI-generated content, including NSFW content, and you’ll also keep an eye on AI-specific threats like prompt injection. Real ownership from day one.

This isn’t an infrastructure, networking or DevSecOps role: we’re looking for application security depth.

Key Responsibilities

Application security (the core of the role)

  • Review code every week to catch vulnerabilities before they ship

  • Find, prioritize and drive fixes for real vulnerabilities across the stack, not surface-level issues

Audits and pentests

  • Coordinate external security audits and penetration tests

  • Challenge findings where needed, and follow them through to fixes

Engineering and automation

  • Automate security work and build the tools you need to scale it

  • Use AI tools daily in your security work: code review, pentests and scripting

Ownership and communication

  • Own security end to end with little support, and decide what matters most

  • Explain technical risk in plain words to the team and leadership

  • Cover security alerts, including occasional night and weekend on-call

Also part of the role (lighter)

  • Keep a simple risk register and GRC documentation up to date

  • Share security updates with the team and run awareness training

  • Watch emerging AI threats (prompt injection, jailbreaks, content filter bypass) and incidents at our AI providers

Your Qualifications

Must-haves

  • 2+ years of hands-on security experience

  • Hands-on AppSec, not compliance only: you review code regularly and can walk us through a real vulnerability you found and fixed

  • Audits and pentests: you’ve coordinated an external audit or pentest and followed the findings through to fixes

  • Engineering workflows: you ship code with Git/GitHub, script in Python or Bash, and have recent hands-on work on a modern web stack (e.g. Rails, Node; GCP, Heroku or similar)

  • Ownership with little support: you’ve been the sole or lead security person, or owned a security area on your own. You’ve reviewed code or tested systems every week in the last 2 years, and you explain risk clearly to non-technical people

  • AI in your daily work: you use AI tools every day in your security work

  • A hacker mindset: You love breaking things to make them safer, and security isn’t only your job: you do it for fun too, through bug bounties, CTFs, research, write-ups or your own tools.

Nice-to-haves

  • ⭐ AI/LLM security testing (prompt injection, jailbreaking): a strong plus

  • Experience at an AI company or a scale-up

  • GRC awareness

  • Familiarity with MDM and access management

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🧢 Goal-orientated, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - you are comfortable working in an environment with products that are based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

What We Offer

📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

Vous intégrerez l'équipe technique en tant que développeur front-end contributeur, avec trois axes de travail complémentaires.

Axe 1 - Contribution au delivery (Azure / Azure DevOps)

Participation active aux activités de développement sur la base de code front-end React, dans un projet conduit selon les méthodologies SDD (Spec Driven Development) et TDD (Test Driven Development) : chaque fonctionnalité est spécifiée avant d'être implémentée, et chaque composant est couvert par des tests écrits en amont du code de production.

Axe 2 - Tuning des pipelines GenAI et optimisation des tokens IA

L'équipe intègre des outils d'assistance par IA générative (Claude, Copilot) dans son workflow de développement quotidien.

Vous mènerez des travaux d'expérimentation et d'optimisation sur ce volet :

- Analyse et audit des usages IA actuels au sein de l'équipe (prompts, contextes, coûts en tokens)

- Conception et test de stratégies de prompting adaptées aux tâches front-end récurrentes (génération de composants, revue de code, rédaction de tests)

- Mise en place de templates de prompts normalisés réutilisables par l'équipe

- Expérimentation sur la compression de contexte et le découpage de tâches pour réduire la consommation de tokens sans dégrader la qualité des sorties

- Rédaction d'un guide de bonnes pratiques IA à destination de l'équipe engineering

Objectif : réduire le coût IA de l'équipe tout en maximisant la valeur produite par les outils d'assistance.

Axe 3 - Optimisation de la méthodologie d'ingénierie logicielle et des interfaces

Dans un contexte de forte montée en charge (fusion-acquisition, équipe en croissance), la rigueur méthodologique est un facteur clé de succès.Vous contribuerez à structurer et améliorer les pratiques de l'équipe, notamment sur les aspects liés au développement des interfaces :

- Documentation des patterns d'architecture front-end retenus (routing, gestion des formulaires, fetching)

- Contribution à l'outillage de l'équipe : scripts, configs ESLint/Prettier, règles de boundaries

Cet axe permettra notamment de mettre en pratique les compétences acquises en Interaction Humain-Machine, en travaillant sur la conception et la cohérence des composants d'interface, la gestion des interactions utilisateur et leur intégration dans un Design System réutilisable.

1. CONTEXTE


Prisme.ai construit le socle du SI agentique souverain.

Les logiciels dont les entreprises ont besoin sont de plus en plus générés par des agents. Le sujet n’est plus la technologie. Le sujet est de livrer la bonne expérience pour chaque usage sans transformer le SI en patchwork d’outils, de silos et de colle entre eux. C’est le problème que nous résolvons.

Prisme.ai est une stack unique pour créer des applications web, des agents (conversationnels ou autonomes) et des workflows, et les déployer partout où l’entreprise en a besoin : web, Teams, portails, MCP, APIs. Deploy everywhere.

L’architecture est scalable et traçable by design. Elle s’exécute en on-premise ou sur plusieurs clouds à la fois, avec n’importe quel modèle, sous la gouvernance de l’entreprise. Chaque agent a une identité, des permissions et des outils gouvernés, et chacune de ses actions est tracée.

Toute la plateforme est exposée en MCP. Équipes techniques et métiers manipulent les mêmes capacités, chacune avec ses outils : du no-code pour les uns, du code pour les autres.

Prisme.ai tourne en production chez des entreprises de la banque, de l’énergie, des télécoms, de l’industrie et du secteur public, avec des milliers d’agents en service.

Prisme.ai est une entreprise indépendante, autofinancée et rentable. Nous ne brûlons pas de cash pour grandir : nous grandissons parce que nos clients restent et étendent leurs usages.


2. CE QUE VOUS ALLEZ CONSTRUIRE


En tant qu’AI Software Engineer, vous construisez des agents et des capacités pensés comme des produits conçus une fois, réutilisés d’un client à l’autre.

Vous partez de cas d’usage réels chez nos clients, et vous en tirez ce qui se généralise :

  • des agents packagés, prêts à être déployés et configurés dans une autre entreprise ;
  • des capacités réutilisables (skills, connecteurs, serveurs MCP) que les équipes métiers et techniques attachent à leurs propres agents.

Tout cela doit fonctionner là où vivent nos clients : en on-premise, dans des environnements à hauts standards de sécurité, et au contact de SI legacy qui n’ont pas été conçus pour l’IA.

Quelques exemples de sujets sur lesquels vous pourriez intervenir :

  • Un agent métier construit pour une banque, rendu paramétrable et déployable chez d’autres filiales.
  • Des connecteurs vers des applications legacy (bases historiques, APIs internes, mainframes exposés par des services intermédiaires), utilisables en lecture ou en écriture avec des droits gouvernés.
  • Le RAG agentique : des agents qui explorent les documents avec des opérations comme grep, cat ou sed, pour une meilleure précision et moins de tokens consommés.
  • L’évaluation de la qualité des agents en production : critères, jeux de tests, mesure, itération.
  • Le bon format pour chaque usage. Un agent n’est pas toujours la meilleure réponse : parfois une application ou un workflow accède directement à la donnée, plus vite et pour moins cher.

Nous attendons une démarche d’ingénieur plus qu’une expertise sur un framework donné : poser le problème, formuler des hypothèses, mesurer, comparer plusieurs options et assumer des compromis explicites entre valeur, coût, délai et risque.

Vous travaillez avec les équipes métiers de nos clients et avec nos équipes Produit, Tech, Customer Success et Support. Vous voyez directement l’effet de ce que vous livrez.


3. PÉRIMÈTRE DE RESPONSABILITÉ


Systèmes d’IA

  • Concevoir et développer des agents, des systèmes RAG et des workflows agentiques, du prototype à la production.
  • Traduire un besoin métier en système fiable, mesurable et conforme aux exigences de sécurité des clients et à l’AI Act.
  • Contribuer aux choix d’architecture IA : orchestration, prompting, choix des modèles, gestion du contexte et des coûts.

Mise en production

  • Partir du problème métier réel avec les équipes clientes, avant de proposer une solution.
  • Livrer par incréments, du premier prototype jusqu’à l’usage à l’échelle.
  • Définir les stratégies d’évaluation, de tests et de qualité, et les faire vivre en production.
  • Rendre les équipes clientes autonomes sur ce qui a été construit.

Plateforme

  • Concevoir les agents et les capacités comme des produits : paramétrables, documentés, versionnés, réutilisables d’un client à l’autre.
  • Développer des skills, connecteurs et serveurs MCP, y compris vers des SI legacy.
  • Garantir que chaque composant respecte les exigences de sécurité des clients et fonctionne en on-premise comme en cloud.
  • Proposer, spécifier et implémenter des évolutions produit à partir du terrain.
  • Participer au support technique de niveau ingénierie sur votre périmètre.

4. PRINCIPES DE TRAVAIL

  • Le résultat client avant la fonctionnalité. Un système d’IA qui n’est pas utilisé ne vaut rien.
  • Penser produit, pas projet. Ce que vous construisez pour un client doit pouvoir servir aux suivants.
  • Approche ingénierie. Comprendre avant de construire. Raisonner à partir des faits et des mesures. Rendre les compromis explicites.
  • Mesurer, pas supposer. Un agent sans évaluation est une démo, pas un produit.
  • Pragmatisme et frugalité. La solution la plus simple qui fonctionne. Sobriété en calcul et en appels aux modèles.
  • Ownership. Autonomie et responsabilité, du besoin à la production.
  • Apprentissage continu. L’état de l’art bouge chaque mois, nous aussi.


5. CE QUI N’EST PAS FACILE


Les besoins métiers sont rarement bien définis au départ. Les LLM ne sont pas déterministes, et rendre un agent fiable demande de la méthode, pas seulement du prompting. Nos clients sont régulés : leurs environnements sont souvent on-premise, cloisonnés, avec des SI anciens et des règles de sécurité strictes. Construire quelque chose de réutilisable dans ces conditions est plus difficile que de livrer un projet unique. C’est précisément ce que nous vous demandons.

Vous serez en contact direct avec les clients, y compris quand quelque chose ne marche pas. Si vous préférez travailler loin des utilisateurs, ce poste n’est pas pour vous.


6. ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL


  • Semaine de 4 ou 5 jours, au choix, à temps plein. Une organisation d’équipe qui garantit la continuité de service pour nos clients.
  • Mode hybride : présentiel à Toulouse / Blagnac et télétravail, avec des déplacements ponctuels.
  • Une équipe resserrée où chaque contribution se voit dans le produit.
  • Montée en compétences sur les architectures agentiques, l’évaluation des systèmes d’IA et le multi-cloud.


7. PROFIL RECHERCHÉ


Nous sommes ouverts à différents niveaux de séniorité. Nous cherchons des personnes curieuses, rigoureuses, qui apprennent vite et aiment voir leur travail utilisé.

  • Une expérience concrète de construction de systèmes à base de LLM : RAG, agents, workflows agentiques, en projet professionnel, personnel ou open source.
  • La maîtrise de Python ou TypeScript, des APIs et de l’intégration de systèmes.
  • Une sensibilité à l’évaluation : savoir dire si un système d’IA fonctionne, et le prouver.
  • Une démarche de résolution de problème éprouvée. Vous savez décomposer un sujet flou, remonter un problème jusqu’à sa cause et expliquer vos arbitrages.
  • L’aisance pour échanger avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques, et reformuler un besoin.
  • Atouts : MCP, intégration avec des SI legacy, environnements on-premise ou sécurisés, cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, Outscale…), Kubernetes, CI/CD, bases de données.

The squad: Database Observability

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About The Job


As a Applied AI, Frontier Data Engineering, Staff, you will build the systems behind some of the hardest problems Mistral takes on.

You join our team of engineers in Applied AI. We gravitate towards hard problems, decide how to solve them, and ship fast. You work closely with our customer-facing teams, and what works goes into production with our customers and across the company. When a project needs it, you work directly on customer engagements.

We're looking for a strong software engineer who builds end to end and has shipped ML or GenAI systems to production. You've felt the pain of models that pass every eval and fail on real data, and of quality that drifts after launch. You've also felt the data engineering pain: pipelines that break silently, schemas that change under you, and backfills that take a weekend. Data engineering is your edge. You turn messy, large-scale data into systems that hold up.

You think like a founder. You start from the customer's problem, not the technology. You measure success by the value you deliver, and you care about building experiences people love to use. You like working at the edge of what AI can do today, and you push past it.

Your scope is end to end, from first prototype to production. Your depth in data architecture helps set the standard for how the team designs and delivers systems. You know lakehouse and data mesh patterns well enough to know when they fit and when they're overkill. You've designed ontologies and data models, and you know that getting them right is as much art as science.

What you will do

  • Build AI systems end to end, from first prototype to production.

  • Design the data architecture underneath them: ingestion, processing, storage, and the data models and ontologies that make messy data usable.

  • Build distributed pipelines that process large volumes of documents, code, logs, and multimodal content for retrieval, agentic workflows, and fine-tuning.

  • Turn what works for one customer into patterns and platforms that work across many, without rebuilding each time.

  • Make systems hold up under real load: throughput, latency, cost, and failure recovery are part of the design from the start.

  • Build data governance into the systems themselves: ownership, access control, lineage, retention, and privacy for sensitive enterprise data.

  • Build the evaluation loop: labeling with LLMs and humans, versioned eval datasets, and checks that catch quality drift before customers do.

  • Set the standard for how the team designs and ships data systems.

  • Work with researchers, engineers, and customer-facing teams to turn hard problems into systems people rely on.


What We're Looking For

  • You have full ability to ship across the stack: proficient NodeJS e.g. NextJS/Express/Fastify or similar or Python e.g. FastAPI. You are confident with TypeScript + React/NextJS or similar. Solid beats polished.

  • You have 5+ years of experience building and running production data-intensive pipelines with distributed processing (for example Spark, Ray, Beam, or Dask) and orchestration tools (for example Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect) with structured and unstructured data.

  • You have experience with retrieval-augmented generation, agentic use cases, or LLM evaluation, and a clear view of how data quality drives model quality.

  • You work autonomously: you find the problem, decide the approach, and own the outcome.

  • You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, and are fluent in English.

Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

About the company

At Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.”

By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology.

With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber.

Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.

Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.

About the role

Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona, Palma, Dublin, or Casablanca.

Own the backend of a white-label travel platform as it adds new verticals. 

Hotels and flights are live. Experiences launch within weeks, and car rentals and more payment providers come next. Our clients are travel brands, banks, and influencers, so every launch brings a new challenge and a chance to design it properly.You'll step in as the backend owner at a pivotal moment. You'll shape the architecture, lead the integrations for each new vertical, and stay hands-on in the code. We've moved quickly to get here, so there's real room to set the standards and clean up the foundations as we grow.This is a role with real ownership. You'll work directly with the backend lead, and within about six months you'll be making the backend decisions yourself.

What makes it interesting for you:

  • You get real technical authority. You become the primary backend decision-maker for a product line, working directly with the backend lead and engineering leadership. Your architecture choices stay in the product, and the role has room to grow as the platform and team expand.
  • You build on a product that is still taking shape. The platform is heading toward Shopify-level customization, with modular components and configurations for very different clients. You'll build foundations that later verticals depend on.
  • You get variety. Each client brings an odd requirement, and the good ideas often become features for other clients. You'll learn something new most weeks.
  • You join a stable team. The team has worked together for two to three years, and the engineers look out for each other.

Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre.

The kind of problems you’ll work on:

  • How do we design the backend so that adding a vertical, such as experiences or car rentals, doesn't mean rebuilding what already works?
  • Which pieces of existing technical debt hold back reliability or delivery speed, and what is the cleanest order to fix them while shipping?
  • How do we integrate third-party travel APIs and payment providers so that bookings stay reliable when a supplier is slow or fails?
  • How should our schedulers, cron jobs, and workers be built so they stay dependable as traffic grows?
  • How do we keep AWS infrastructure performing for client launches without over-engineering it?

You’ll work on problems where the product, technical approach, and best path forward are still being figured out. 
The role is backend-heavy and product-driven. You should be comfortable going from idea to design, implementation, and real usage, without needing detailed specs.
A good way to think of it is: you build the first version that proves something works.

This role fits if you:

  • Have 4 to 5 years in backend engineering, including at least 2 years of full-time Node.js and TypeScript in production. Java or Python backgrounds are welcome if you have since worked in Node full time.
  • Have designed REST APIs and relational schemas in PostgreSQL.
  • Have worked with background jobs, schedulers, or workers that talk to third-party systems.
  • Have roughly two years of hands-on AWS, enough to run a product that has to handle real traffic.
  • Have taken ownership of a product's outcomes beyond the tickets assigned to you, and stepped in when a teammate was out.
  • Have experience leading technical decisions for a team, or have been in a position to. You still write code every day.

Nuitée is fast-moving, low on process, and high on ownership. This suits people who are comfortable with ambiguity, pace, and responsibility. It is less suited to people who prefer structured environments and clearly defined scope from day one.

Travel experience helps but is not required. Experience in a fast-moving product company probably is.

We move quickly and have little process. You'll see 10 plus features moving in parallel, and priorities can change when a client needs something.
You'll contribute code in your first days and take decisions with incomplete information. The first couple of weeks are about getting used to this rhythm, and after that you have a lot of autonomy.

If that resonates, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2 to 3 weeks.

Why Nuitee?

At Nuitée, we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.

  • Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale.
  • World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally.
  • Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup.
  • Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others
  • AI-Driven Innovation: Nuitée is uniquely positioned to power the future of travel in the AI era—enabling seamless, intelligent, and hyper-personalized travel interactions.

By joining Nuitée, you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining platform. You’ll work on a global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries, redefine a multi-trillion-dollar industry, and grow with us—Nuitée is the place for you.

Les Nouvelles Recrues is hiring on behalf of our client Fabriq

  • Our client, its business and its ambition

The ambition. Our client Fabriq is bringing European industry into the 21st century: making factories more competitive and frontline teams more autonomous. This is not only a software play, it is the industrial relocalisation project.

The business. Fabriq is the SaaS platform that replaces the whiteboards and Excel spreadsheets still running 80% of industrial sites. Operators, team leads and plant managers track real-time KPIs (safety, quality, lead time, productivity), surface and solve shop-floor problems, run their daily routines and collaborate across teams in one place. Fabriq's long-term ambition is to become the Operating System of every production floor.

The proof.

  • 700+ industrial sites equipped across 43+ countries.
  • Reference customers such as Safran, Airbus, Renault, Scania, LVMH, Andros, Bel, Merck and Lonza.
  • Profitable since late 2024, then €22M raised in June 2025 with Expedition Capital to accelerate in the US, the UK and DACH.
  • A team of :140 people, and an AI roadmap that is already in customers' hands rather than on a slide.
  • The role

Context: You join Fabriq's AI team, currently a three-person unit led by Jean (Product Lead) alongside two Senior Engineers: Halim & Rafik. This team operates as a prototyping squad at the front edge of the company: it tests new ideas, measures market appetite and decides whether Fabriq goes there. Products are in alpha, cycles are short, the roadmap is directional. The team also works weekly with Octave, co-founder, which gives you direct exposure to the strategic decisions.

Objective: Become the third engineer on AI alongside Halim and Rafik, reach full autonomy on the stack and the customer context within 6 months, and take Fabriq's AI products from alpha to something industrial teams rely on every day.

Challenges:

  • Taking AI prototypes to production quality. Conversational and voice-driven agents, plugged into real industrial data and used by real teams on the floor. You take them from alpha to something people rely on daily: answer quality, reliability, and the cost per interaction that decides whether a use case scales or gets dropped.
  • Prototyping to convince. Part of the roadmap is co-built with partner customers, which means it is sold before it is built. Specs move as customers shape them, timelines are tight, and you build fast to prove a use case is worth pursuing. Testing a lot and abandoning a lot is part of the deal.
  • Agentic engineering from scratch. No Mastra, no LangGraph, no off-the-shelf framework. Everything is hand-built in TypeScript and Deno on top of frontier models called through AWS Bedrock. When the team needs something like agent memory compaction, you design it yourself. This is custom, sparsely documented territory, and that is precisely the technical interest of the role.
  • Setting the technical direction with Halim and Rafik. You are the third engineer, not an extra pair of hands: code reviews, architecture debates, and the freedom to arrive with your own proposals rather than waiting for a ticket.

Your first 3 months are dedicated to ramping up on the Fabriq stack and product, contributing to the AI features already in the hands of beta customers, and shipping your first POCs.

  • Skills and experience

Must-haves:

  • Software engineering depth: 4 to 5 years minimum. Real craftsmanship, clean design decisions, and the ability to explain the architecture trade-offs you made and why.
  • Daily hands-on use of AI to build software. Having never used AI to develop is a deal-breaker on this role.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You move forward, decide and ship when nothing is specified in advance, and you adapt when the roadmap shifts.
  • Builder mindset with evidence. Concrete examples of things you built from zero, prototyped, tested and iterated on.

Nice-to-haves (optional):

  • A first hands-on experience with agentic systems. Expertise is welcome when it is real: a strong engineer with curiosity and early agentic work beats a self-declared two-year agentic expert who cannot explain concretely what they built.
  • A data background. The testing logic differs from pure software: working on datasets and analysing where a system succeeds and where it fails is a plus, and it can be learned at Fabriq.
  • Collaborative posture. The team will evangelise AI across the other product teams. Showing and explaining your work is expected.

Stack:

Backend: TypeScript on Deno. Frontend: Vue.js. Infrastructure: AWS with EKS, Terraform, plus Kubernetes for on-prem customer deployments. Observability: Honeycomb and Sentry. On the AI side: frontier models called through AWS Bedrock, with everything agentic hand-built and no framework on top.

  • Package and working conditions
  • Salary: €70K to €80K fixed, depending on experience.
  • Location: Fabriq's Paris office at 18 rue Yves Toudic, 75010. Presence matters most during onboarding and for team dynamics. Remote is possible, Paris is preferred.
  • Working language: French & English, fluency required.
  • Benefits: 7 weeks of vacation per year, Alan health insurance, Swile meal vouchers, a company event every quarter and an annual offsite.

Hiring process:

  • Screening call with Les Nouvelles Recrues, Fabriq's recruitment partner: 30 to 45 min
  • Technical interview with a Fabriq technical profile: 1h45 (project review, system design and product mindset, technical Q&A)
  • Team fit with Jean, Halim & Rafik : 1h
  • Reference checks: 2 references
  • Meeting with Octave, Fabriq co-founder: 30 min

About Share

Share is a venture-backed startup building the global marketplace for bandwidth. We enable anyone to build their own programmable internet network, in seconds. Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. Only the largest tech companies have escaped this, by spending billions to build their own physical networks. Share is giving that power to everyone.

Infrastructure providers sell their services in the Share Marketplace; giving builders, AI agents and enterprises the ability to build their own global backbone via an API layer. The path, the performance, how long they need it and paying only for what they use.


The role

We are hiring a Founding Engineer to take ownership of core platform architecture as we rebuild for a system roughly 50x the scale of what we had before. You'll design and scale distributed systems from scratch (this is deep systems-architecture work, not feature development on an existing system.) You will work directly with the Head of Development and a small team of engineers to ship production systems operating at global scale.

Non-negotiable

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with real, hands-on ownership of designing and scaling a production system from scratch. You can describe specific production incidents at scale (what broke, why, and what you changed) not just system-design-interview theory.

  • Deep TypeScript/Node.js expertise. You should be able to design a NestJS microservice from scratch, not just work in one.

  • Strong PostgreSQL skills. You can design schemas for complex, high-throughput production data, write migrations, and reason about transaction isolation and locking.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar). You understand the difference between request-reply and fire-and-forget patterns and when to use each.

  • You ship. You can take a spec document and turn it into production code without waiting for someone to break it into small tasks.

Nice to have, not required: prior fintech/payments experience or blockchain/distributed-ledger exposure

AI-augmented engineering (required mindset)

We expect every engineer at Share to use AI tools as a daily part of their workflow. This is how we operate. Our entire project planning, specification, and documentation process runs through AI-assisted sessions. Our codebase includes AI-readable context files. We use Claude for architecture decisions, code review, spec generation, and technical writing.

What this means for you:

  • You already use AI coding assistants (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) daily and can articulate how they change your workflow.

  • You are comfortable working with AI-generated specifications and can critically evaluate them, push back where they are wrong, and extend them where they are incomplete.

  • You see AI as a force multiplier that lets a small team operate at the capacity of a much larger one. You are not threatened by it; you are faster because of it.

  • You are willing to contribute to improving our AI-assisted workflows

Compensation & Details:

  • Competitive Salary & Equity package

  • Additional Benefits

  • Paid Business Travel when needed

  • Ownership in a venture-backed early stage startup building the future of physical and digital infrastructure in Africa

Safran.AI - De l'IA qui opère dans le réel 

Filiale de Safran Electronics & Defense, Safran.AI conçoit des solutions d'IA appliquées à des données complexes telles que les images satellite haute résolution, les flux vidéo FMV et les signaux acoustiques. Ces solutions s'appuient sur des algorithmes capables de détecter et d'identifier automatiquement des objets d'intérêt dans les secteurs du renseignement, de la défense et de l'aéronautique. 

Depuis son intégration à Safran en septembre 2024, Safran.AI contribue également à la transformation du groupe, en appliquant les solutions d’IA aux domaines de l’industrie 4.0.  À titre d’exemple, l’analyse d’images automatisée par l’IA peut assister les contrôleurs en charge de l’inspection de pièces critiques en les aidant à détecter les anomalies éventuelles à partir de clichés numériques.   

Fort de nos 250 collaborateurs, vous évoluerez au sein d’équipes passionnées et pluridisciplinaires, réunissant des talents parmi les plus reconnus du secteur, tous animés par une même exigence d’excellence et d’innovation technologique.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de développement travaillant sur des projets nécessitants des déploiements on-premise et vous serez responsable de la conception et du développement continu de notre produit et de notre infrastructure en utilisant essentiellement Python, PostgreSQL, React, Typescript et d'autres technologies innovantes.
Au-delà de l'exécution, vous serez force de proposition sur les choix d'architecture et les compromis techniques : vous challengez l'existant, proposez des alternatives et documentez vos décisions. Les agents IA (Claude, Copilot ou équivalents) font partie intégrante de notre boîte à outils quotidienne, et nous cherchons quelqu'un qui sait s'en servir avec discernement — pour aller plus vite sans sacrifier la rigueur.
